item.title: AstraZeneca opens new global strategic R&D center in Kendall Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts
item.description: WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--AstraZeneca today announced the opening of its newest global strategic research and development (R&D) center, in Kendall Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts. The new state-of-the-art facility builds on the Company’s existing presence in Cambridge and Boston and places its scientists at the heart of one of the world’s most innovative life sciences ecosystems. item.title: Tangent Robotics lève 4,5 millions d'euros en pré-amorçage visant à faire progresser la dextérité des robots grâce à la motricité fine
item.description: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Chez l'être humain, le développement complet de la motricité fine peut durer 20 ans. item.title: Schwab Initiates Secondary Listing on the Texas Stock Exchange
